_comment: Recorded null-responder baselines, one per battery. A rate here is what a canned non-answer scores against that battery, measured through the SAME expectation set the engine is scored with (guard_expectations.expected_with_guards). An engine rate at or below its battery's null rate is not published (DEC-245). Re-record with: python scripts/hedge_responder_probe.py --battery <name>

adversarial.note: The canned hedge passes every adversarial and negative case. min_length, the fallback keyword_none, tone_judge and affirms_judge all pass on a fluent hedge: they catch empty, canned and AI-revealing responses, which a hedge is not. No engine rate over this battery is publishable until the battery is re-authored to discriminate.
